review.method: 31 encoded samples over the entire 38-second film, including 0–3.6 s human chronology, interface reveals, preview click, every scene join, feedback transition, revised hero/caption and final frame; full-size detail inspection at 11.8, 15.8, 27 and 33.5 seconds. Sub-composition snapshots and full decode checks supplement this sampled visual review. No continuous real-time playback or new listening claim.
ui_findings: Dark Slack reconstruction follows the supplied screenshot: charcoal app background, darker sidebar/topbar, centered search, compact navigation, blue selection, bordered composer and appropriately separated messages.

Readable deterministic typography and stable geometry. Brand headings share a consistent left edge; page preview uses clearer spacing and hierarchy. Matching dark thread makes feedback visually continuous with the request scene.
Preview thumbnail is a local capture of the rebuilt page, not a generated approximation. Cursor uses the installed simulated-cursor geometry, with one press/pulse at the preview action.
Caption is a separate transparent sub-composition and title-safe track. Initial authoring error covering the page was detected by visual review, corrected and rechecked before final render.
human_findings: Reuses the exact reviewed purposeful-contact v2 asset, source range 0–3.6 s at native speed; no regenerated or retimed human footage.

Separate hand roles, supported forearms, laptop-directed attention and quiet posture are carried forward. Brief early hand reposition and restrained/soft facial detail remain; no improved skin realism or perfect contact is claimed.
New title placement leaves the face and hands unobscured. Warm source lighting suits the cream/orange brand; no new beauty or grading treatment.
review.audio: Encoded audio PCM matches the prior complete master exactly. Narration, music, effects and original cue timing preserved.
review.reviewed_warning: Kite app icon intentionally reused as navigation icon and message avatar; no duplicated video/audio track.
unverified: Actual hardware cursor or key response

cost.note: Reuses existing media and audio; no budget reset or new paid generation. Unknown costs are not zero.
